material_codec_frame_correction.diagonal_collapse: Normalized WHT has U_ic^2=1/128, hence every diagonal entry of U T U^T equals trace(T)/128. Dropping off-diagonal terms therefore reduces to Euclidean assignment up to a scalar, losing the proposed channel heterogeneity.
material_codec_frame_correction.exact_counterexample: For standard Hadamard128, choose native diagonal T_jj=1 when bit2(j)=0 and2 otherwise. This respects Qwen rotary pairing because j and j+64 have equal T. Then U T U^T=1.5I-0.5P_xor4, coupling coordinate0 to4 across distinct4D product-code blocks.
material_codec_frame_correction.exact_real_pullback: A native post-RoPE metric H_native becomes C=U H_native U^T for codec error coordinates. Native diagonal T generally gives dense C, so independent diagonal-weighted4D nearest-word assignment does not follow.
material_codec_frame_correction.observed_current_R7_frame: Frozen key bank applies centered normalized WHT before encode_key; frozen reader applies WHT(q) and adds the native mean bias. Existing G4 codewords are in this WHT frame.
material_codec_frame_correction.residual_floor_requirement: Re-encoding K23 does not by itself prove metric nonincrease; retain the entire old base/gain/mean/sign/alpha point as a feasible candidate and evaluate the same actual decode objective. A matched H=I search control must share the search/residual rules.
valid_NOT_RUN_corrections: Keep dense C and perform bounded block-coordinate legal G4 index search with original reader/mean/gain preserved.
Or derive a4x4 block-diagonal envelope: B_aa=C_aa+(sum_{b!=a}||C_ab||2)I4, which satisfies C<=B. It can retain within-block correlations, but useful nonisotropy and actual cost are unmeasured.

mathematical_checks.rotary_envelope: After permuting into true2D pairs, c_ab=||S_ab||2 is symmetric. Unit block rotations preserve r_a=||e_a||. Sum_ab c_ab r_a r_b<=sum_a(sum_b c_ab)r_a^2 by2r_a r_b<=r_a^2+r_b^2. Thus R S R^T<=blockdiag(row_sum(c)*I2). Frobenius block norms give a looser valid envelope.
